title: Instant Pot Frozen Potato Soup
description: This Instant Pot potato soup features frozen O'Brien hash browns cooked with condensed chicken soup and cream cheese for easy, speedy preparation.
ingredients: 1 (28 ounce) package frozen potatoes O'Brien with onions and peppers
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
0.25 teaspoon ground black pepper, or more to taste

steps.text: Pour chicken broth into a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot). Add O'Brien potatoes in an even layer. Dollop condensed soup over potatoes. Place cream cheese on top. Do not stir.
Close and lock the lid. Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set the timer for 15 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.

Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Use the quick-release method to release remaining pressure. Add Italian seasoning, garlic salt, and black pepper. Stir to incorporate.
